methodology.Details: Analysis covers 768 distribution lines from March 2025 to February 2026 across five anonymised sites.
All composition shares are calculated using recorded Line_Weight in kilograms.
Relative 100-point score: food-group diversity 25; protein-rich share 20; fruit/vegetable share 20; plant-protein share 15; nutritious-category share 10; limitation of discretionary foods 10.
Protein, pulses-legumes, seeds-nuts and processed meat.
Confectionery, ultra-processed food and processed meat.
Full points at 15% protein-rich share, 25% fruit/vegetable share, 10% plant-protein share and 85% nutritious-category share. Discretionary-food points decline to zero at 20%.
The score is a relative basket-composition indicator. It is not a clinical dietary-adequacy measure and does not estimate individual consumption.
Candidate nutrient values are generic reference estimates per 100 g and should be replaced by exact product labels or an approved food-composition database before publication.
Public retail prices were used where available. Estimated entries and all prices should be replaced with FoodForward-approved procurement quotations for final decisions.
Recommendations consider shelf life, refrigeration, cooking requirements, transport weight, allergy risk and likely availability.
SITE_005 has only about 335 kg recorded and should not be compared directly with mature sites until completeness and operating period are verified.
Prioritise candidates with weighted score at least 4.3, then test combinations against a defined monthly budget and operational constraints.
